title: Housing platforms and support expats compare alongside rental agencies
intro: Many expats combine **rental-agency mediation** with **DIY listing platforms** and arrival setup (insurance, tax timing). These listings are soft discovery for related housing and settling support — **not a ranking of rental agencies or brokers**, and not fee or contract guarantees. Confirm agency fees, landlord arrangements and listing terms before you commit.
